metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2016 · Medici

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2016 · Vikingane
metas.description: Viking life at the close of the 8th century.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2017 · Genius

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2015 · Versailles
metas.description: In 1667, 28-year-old all-powerful king of France, Louis XIV, decides to build the greatest palace in the world - Versailles. But drained budget, affairs and political intrigues complicate things.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2018 · The Looming Tower
metas.description: A look at how the rivalry between the CIA and FBI inadvertently set the stage for the tragedy of 9/11 and the war in Afghanistan.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2017 · Cable Girls

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2019 · Gentleman Jack

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2019 · The Devil Next Door

metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 2018 · Mr. Sunshine
metas.description: A young boy who ends up in the U.S. after the 1871 Shinmiyangyo incident returns to Korea at a historical turning point and falls for a noblewoman.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2019 · Greatest Events of WWII in Colour

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2015 · Show Me a Hero

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2019 · Vienna Blood

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2017 · The Son

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2017 · Little Boy Blue
